Use case: ui-mockup, single state variation of the user-approved Sanctuary Launcher screen in input image 1.
This is NOT an alternative design. Reuse its exact visual system and composition: white opaque background, grey thin separators, centered content column, official grey beveled SANCTUARY logo plus small Launcher in the top-left header, fictitious green "Serveur en ligne · 12/20" at upper right, one shared outlined panel with FIVE rows numbered 1 through 5, consistent sans serif typography and button shapes. Keep the panel geometry, margins, row order and footer. Target the exact natural 1486 x 1059 desktop aspect ratio, no devices/browser frames, no collages.
Row labels must remain: 1 Discord, 2 Microsoft, 3 Accès Sanctuary, 4 Code de personnage, 5 Installation. Numbers must remain visible even when completed. Highlight ONLY the active row, subtly, and display the active step/action as the large main heading above the block. Do not split into three sections or use a generic welcome title. The small eyebrow gives the step number and name.
Green checks/statuses indicate completed required prerequisites; uncompleted future states are neutral. Optional row 4 is always labelled "Facultatif". It must NEVER be a requirement to copy a code before installation or play.
There must be one clear primary action or, when waiting, one useful next action. Always include an enabled neutral "Tous les outils" button below the panel, opening all native Prism options. A Discord/Microsoft/admission state must not lock the entire local-tools manager.
Footer: "Actualités", "Site Sanctuary", "Aide", small "Maquette · données fictives". No real emails, secrets, identity documents, or actual admission codes. All content is fictional. Date anchor November 8, 2026; no need to show dates. 12/20 is simultaneous occupancy, never a 20-member cap.
Keep every exact French accent readable and all controls unclipped. Do not add features or decorative imagery. One image = one state of this same product.
